title: Lexicon of the dialect of Rögn (Arogno), Ticino
description: Dialect words with Italian and English meanings, example sentences and verb conjugations from the course Cors da dialett da Rögn (Arogno, Lugano district) and related Ticinese texts.
citation: Maguire, Michael. Lexicon of the dialect of Rögn (Arogno), Ticino. Based on the course Cors da dialett da Rögn taught by Guido Casellini. https://github.com/michaelmaguire/languages-dialett
